data: Does the red dashed line represent the 'Im-greedy' strategy in the right plot?

The caption explains that the strategies are described in Section 3, and the red dashed line represents the 'lm-greedy' strategy. The legend on the right side of the figure confirms this. Therefore, the red dashed line indeed represents the 'lm-greedy' strategy in the right plot.
